notes: Bhima continuity lock — large powerful build, not photoreal. Bakasura fearsome but comic-mythology, not gore.

bhima.face: Young adult warrior, broad jaw, dark eyes, thick dark mustache, confident calm expression
bhima.hair: Black curly hair in warrior topknot, no peacock feather
bhima.costume: Saffron-yellow or cream dhoti with gold border, bare powerful chest, simple armbands — largest of the Pandavas

bakasura.face: Rakshasa: large, fierce but stylized comic features, not photoreal horror
bakasura.hair: Wild dark hair, optional small horns or topknot
bakasura.costume: Dark forest greens and browns, ragged warrior cloth, large stature towering over trees

kunti.face: Mature noble mother, warm brown skin, serene resolve
kunti.hair: Dark hair with simple gold ornaments
kunti.costume: Saffron or cream sari with gold border

brahmin_father.costume: White cotton dhoti and upper cloth
